items.summary: Stock Market Today: The Dow Jones index and other indexes gain Tuesday on U.S.-Iran peace hopes. Biotech and software stocks show strength.

items.title: NAB to cut 2,500 jobs as bank moves to simplify operations
items.summary: Investing.com -- National Australia Bank plans to cut up to 2,500 jobs over the next year and book a pre-tax restructuring charge of about A$300 million in fiscal 2027 as it seeks to simplify operations and reduce costs amid intensifying competition and rapid technological change.

aus.headline: ASX Slides As Miners Slump
aus.body: Aussie shares closed down on Tuesday as energy and mining stocks were sold off.
aus.why: Energy and mining firms are some of the biggest names on the ASX.

us.headline: Dow Climbs On Iran Peace Hopes
us.body: US stocks rose and oil slipped on hopes of peace between the US and Iran.
us.why: Oil prices feed into what Australians pay at the bowser.

biz.headline: NAB Axing 2,500 Roles
biz.body: National Australia Bank plans to shed up to 2,500 roles over the next year.
biz.why: One of the big four banks is shrinking its workforce to cut costs.
